source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The current progress test replaces Windows, macOS and GTK taskbar contracts with MockRegistrar objects that record setProgressState calls. Its save case checks recorded first/last states and event count while the compose window stays open. These assertions can check publication of progress state, but cannot establish whether a native Windows taskbar receiver keeps the real icon present after garbage collection.
title: Compose progress recorder tests do not establish native taskbar receiver lifetime
